The first candidate was refuted: its guarded stiffness interval lies below 3.53 GPa. The complete-gap check was also undetermined. I’m running another search for a candidate with more margin.

The second search found a candidate with predicted solid fraction 10.58% and stiffness 4.20 GPa. Its calibrated gap estimate is promising, though the raw search estimate starts above 174 kHz. Certification will determine whether it covers the full requested interval.

The final certificate is still pending. None of the candidates has yet been certified to meet all three targets.
